# ankra_pipeline_policy (Resource)

The organisation's pipeline policy (`ankra pipeline policy`): the authority ceiling its Ankra Pipelines may use, which network tiers, credentials, node selectors, tolerations, runtime classes, resources and webhook hosts. There is one per organisation. Only the attributes set in configuration are written; an unset attribute keeps the stored value and reports it. A value the platform refuses is reported against the setting that produced it. The authority request inbox stays a human decision and is not managed here. Managing the policy needs `pipelines.manage`, the read included. Destroy leaves the policy as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_pipeline_policy" "ceiling" {
  allowed_network_tiers  = ["egress-https"]
  allowed_node_selectors = { "ankra.io/node-group" = ["ci"] }
  max_cpu                = "4"
  max_memory             = "8Gi"
  webhook_allowed_hosts  = ["hooks.slack.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_credentials` (Set of String) Credentials pipelines may bind.
- `allowed_network_tiers` (Set of String) Network tiers pipeline steps may ask for.
- `allowed_node_selectors` (Map of List of String) Node selector keys pipeline steps may use, each with the values allowed for it.
- `allowed_runtime_classes` (Set of String) Runtime classes pipeline steps may run under.
- `allowed_tolerations` (Attributes Set) Tolerations pipeline steps may carry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowed_tolerations))
- `external_providers` (Set of String) External providers pipelines may reach.
- `max_agent_tool_calls_per_run` (Number) Most tool calls an agent step may make in one run.
- `max_cache_size` (String) Largest pipeline cache, such as `20Gi`.
- `max_cpu` (String) Most CPU one pipeline step may ask for, as a Kubernetes quantity such as `4`.
- `max_gpu` (Number) Most GPUs one pipeline step may ask for.
- `max_memory` (String) Most memory one pipeline step may ask for, such as `8Gi`.
- `webhook_allowed_hosts` (Set of String) Hosts pipeline webhook steps may call.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_image_prefixes` (Set of String) Image prefixes pipeline steps may run. Owned by the CI settings (`ankra_ci_settings`), so read-only here.
- `id` (String) Always `pipeline_policy`.
- `updated_by` (String) Who last changed the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--allowed_tolerations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowed_tolerations`

Required:

- `effect` (String) Taint effect, such as `NoSchedule`.
- `key` (String) Taint key.
- `operator` (String) `Equal` or `Exists`.
- `value` (String) Taint value; empty for `Exists`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one per organisation; any id imports it.
terraform import ankra_pipeline_policy.ceiling pipeline_policy
```
